_comment: NOT APPLIED. Read-only permissions the admin System Health checks need on fortexa-backend-task-role (backend/services/systemHealth.js). Without them those cards show 'Unknown — permission denied'; nothing else breaks. Apply only with approval: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name fortexa-backend-task-role --policy-name FortexaSystemHealthRead --policy-document file://infrastructure/backend-monitoring/system-health-iam-policy.json  (strip this _comment key first). SES GetSendQuota/GetAccountSendingEnabled are already covered by the attached AmazonSESFullAccess.
